# Fixture for ci_spec's "no spec drives a coverage run against the mounted
# checkout (#952)" guard: the shapes its detector has to tell apart.
#
# NOT a bats file (hence the .txt suffix): it is data the guard scans, and
# it lives outside test/bats/ so the guard's own roster -- every *.bats in
# that tree -- neither runs it nor accuses it.
#
# Each block below is named for what the detector must do with it. The
# guard asserts the whole verdict, so a detector that stops seeing one
# entry point fails HERE, on a file that says which shape it lost, instead
# of quietly passing over a tree that happens to contain none of it today.

@test "FLAG statement-start runner call" {
  run bash -c '
    source /source/script/test/drivers/bats.sh
    _run_coverage
  '
}

@test "FLAG one-liner runner call" {
  run bash -c 'source /source/script/test/drivers/bats.sh; _run_coverage 1/4'
}

@test "FLAG the flag entry" {
  run bash -c 'source /source/script/test/test.sh; main --coverage'
}

@test "FLAG the in-container entry" {
  run bash -c 'source /source/script/test/test.sh; COVERAGE=1 COVERAGE_SHARD=1/4 main --ci'
}

@test "FLAG half-stubbed provenance" {
  # Only the eraser is stubbed. The real _stamp_coverage_head still runs
  # against the real REPO_ROOT and writes /source/coverage/.head-sha.
  run bash -c '
    source /source/script/test/test.sh
    _invalidate_coverage_head() { :; }
    _run_via_compose() { :; }
    main --coverage
  '
}

@test "PASS scratch REPO_ROOT" {
  run bash -c '
    REPO_ROOT="${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR}/repo"
    mkdir -p "${REPO_ROOT}/coverage"
    source /source/script/test/drivers/bats.sh
    _run_coverage
  '
}

@test "PASS both provenance halves stubbed" {
  run bash -c '
    source /source/script/test/test.sh
    _invalidate_coverage_head() { :; }
    _stamp_coverage_head() { :; }
    _run_via_compose() { :; }
    main --coverage
  '
}

@test "IGNORE a runner named in a word list" {
  local _fn
  for _fn in _run_bats_path _run_coverage _run_system; do
    run grep -E "^${_fn}\(\) \{" /source/script/test/drivers/bats.sh
  done
}
